test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ACTION’ is written as ‘DFWFLK’ and ‘BISHOP’ is written as ‘ELVELM’. How will ‘MATTER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘ACTION’ is written as ‘DFWFLK’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74fbfa8ee691eaca8ab51aa6ee929dc1a5a176cc99bbc082f51f6e2274d9d79a.png] 

For, ‘BISHOP’ is written as ‘ELVELM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bad76a08a7217944668b9dff92ee76e9035a92f9ed8db0bab283be45ca2cd6c.png] 

Similarly, for ‘MATTER’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028dedb43a64bb105d82e4dee0f5582d57755eb2f2ca29b58dbc5bbf72a4c48d.png] 

So, **‘MATTER’** will be written as **'PDWQBO'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
